access_block_one_team.name: access_block_one_team
access_block_one_team.where: "access_blocks"."cleared_at" is null and "access_blocks"."team_id" is not null

access_block_one_member.name: access_block_one_member
access_block_one_member.where: "access_blocks"."cleared_at" is null and "access_blocks"."member_id" is not null

access_block_target.name: access_block_target
access_block_target.value: num_nonnulls("access_blocks"."team_id", "access_blocks"."member_id") = 1 and octet_length("access_blocks"."reason") between 1 and 1024 and ("access_blocks"."cleared_at" is null or "access_blocks"."cleared_at" >= "access_blocks"."created_at")

credential_one_active_team.name: credential_one_active_team
credential_one_active_team.where: "access_credentials"."revoked_at" is null and "access_credentials"."team_id" is not null

credential_one_active_staff.name: credential_one_active_staff
credential_one_active_staff.where: "access_credentials"."revoked_at" is null and "access_credentials"."staff_id" is not null

entry_event_kind.name: entry_event_kind
entry_event_kind.value:
("entry_events"."kind" = 'FLOW_OPENED' and "entry_events"."session_id" is null)
  or ("entry_events"."kind" in ('SESSION_ACTIVATED','SESSION_REVOKED') and "entry_events"."session_id" is not null)

entry_flow_shape.name: entry_flow_shape
entry_flow_shape.value:
octet_length("entry_flows"."proof_verifier") = 32 and "entry_flows"."expires_at" = "entry_flows"."created_at" + interval '10 minutes'
    and "entry_flows"."state" in ('OPEN', 'ACTIVATED', 'EXPIRED', 'REVOKED', 'SUPERSEDED')
    and (("entry_flows"."activated_session_id" is null and "entry_flows"."activated_at" is null and "entry_flows"."state" <> 'ACTIVATED')
      or ("entry_flows"."state" <> 'OPEN' and "entry_flows"."activated_session_id" is not null and "entry_flows"."activated_at" is not null and "entry_flows"."activated_at" >= "entry_flows"."created_at" and "entry_flows"."activated_at" < "entry_flows"."expires_at"))

entry_outcome_shape.name: entry_outcome_shape
entry_outcome_shape.value:
octet_length("entry_outcomes"."fingerprint") = 32
    and "entry_outcomes"."language" in ('c','cpp','java','python','javascript') and (("entry_outcomes"."outcome" = 'ACTIVATED' and "entry_outcomes"."session_id" is not null and "entry_outcomes"."reason" is null)
    or ("entry_outcomes"."outcome" = 'REJECTED' and "entry_outcomes"."session_id" is null and "entry_outcomes"."reason" is not null and "entry_outcomes"."reason" in ('ALREADY_ENROLLED','ROUND_UNAVAILABLE','ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE')))

member_round_enrolment.name: member_round_enrolment
member_round_enrolment.value:
("member_rounds"."language" is null and "member_rounds"."enrolled_at" is null and "member_rounds"."first_entry_flow_id" is null)
    or ("member_rounds"."language" is not null and "member_rounds"."language" in ('c','cpp','java','python','javascript') and "member_rounds"."enrolled_at" is not null and "member_rounds"."first_entry_flow_id" is not null)

session_lifetime.name: session_lifetime
session_lifetime.value:
octet_length("participant_sessions"."secret_verifier") = 32 and "participant_sessions"."absolute_expires_at" = "participant_sessions"."created_at" + interval '8 hours'
    and "participant_sessions"."last_activity_at" >= "participant_sessions"."created_at" and "participant_sessions"."last_activity_at" < "participant_sessions"."absolute_expires_at"
    and (("participant_sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "participant_sessions"."revocation_reason" is null) or ("participant_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and "participant_sessions"."revoked_at" >= "participant_sessions"."created_at" and "participant_sessions"."revocation_reason" is not null))

quota_bucket_shape.name: quota_bucket_shape
quota_bucket_shape.value:
"quota_buckets"."kind" in ('AUTH_GLOBAL','AUTH_IP','AUTH_BROWSER','AUTH_CODE','HTTP_GLOBAL','HTTP_IP','READ_MEMBER','MEMBER_COMMAND','READ_STAFF','STAFF_CONFIRM','STAFF_COMMAND')
  and octet_length("quota_buckets"."key_hash") = 32 and "quota_buckets"."rate" > 0 and "quota_buckets"."burst" > 0 and "quota_buckets"."credits" between 0 and "quota_buckets"."burst"::bigint * 60000 and "quota_buckets"."seen_at" >= "quota_buckets"."refilled_at"

replacement_request_shape.name: replacement_request_shape
replacement_request_shape.value:
"replacement_requests"."flow_id"<>"replacement_requests"."parent_flow_id" and octet_length("replacement_requests"."fingerprint")=32 and "replacement_requests"."expected_slot_revision">=0
    and "replacement_requests"."state" in ('PENDING','APPROVED','ACTIVATED','REJECTED','EXPIRED','SUPERSEDED') and length("replacement_requests"."proof_key_id") between 1 and 64
    and (("replacement_requests"."proof_ciphertext" is not null and octet_length("replacement_requests"."proof_ciphertext") between 1 and 4096 and "replacement_requests"."proof_purged_at" is null)
      or ("replacement_requests"."proof_ciphertext" is null and "replacement_requests"."proof_purged_at" is not null))

round_start_shape.name: round_start_shape
round_start_shape.value:
("rounds"."state" in ('DRAFT', 'READY') and "rounds"."started_at" is null and "rounds"."closes_at" is null)
    or ("rounds"."state" not in ('DRAFT', 'READY') and "rounds"."started_at" is not null and "rounds"."closes_at" is not null and "rounds"."closes_at" > "rounds"."started_at")

delivery_shape.name: delivery_shape
delivery_shape.value:
length("session_deliveries"."key_id") between 1 and 64 and (("session_deliveries"."ciphertext" is not null and octet_length("session_deliveries"."ciphertext") between 1 and 4096 and "session_deliveries"."purged_at" is null)
    or ("session_deliveries"."ciphertext" is null and "session_deliveries"."purged_at" is not null))

clock_event_shape.name: clock_event_shape
clock_event_shape.value:
"clock_events"."generation">=0 and "clock_events"."kind" in ('STARTED','FAULT','TRUST_ESTABLISHED','STOPPED')
    and (("clock_events"."kind"='FAULT' and "clock_events"."reason" is not null) or ("clock_events"."kind"<>'FAULT' and "clock_events"."reason" is null))
    and jsonb_typeof("clock_events"."evidence")='object' and octet_length("clock_events"."evidence"::text)<=4096

clock_health_shape.name: clock_health_shape
clock_health_shape.value:
"clock_health"."id"=1 and "clock_health"."fault_generation">=0 and "clock_health"."sequence">=0 and "clock_health"."healthy_count" between 0 and 7
    and "clock_health"."state" in ('STOPPED','STARTING','HEALTHY','WARNING','FAULT')
    and (("clock_health"."runtime_id" is null and "clock_health"."boot_id" is null and not "clock_health"."running") or ("clock_health"."runtime_id" is not null and "clock_health"."boot_id" is not null))
    and (("clock_health"."fault_latched" and "clock_health"."fault_reason" is not null and "clock_health"."fault_generation">0) or (not "clock_health"."fault_latched" and "clock_health"."fault_reason" is null))
    and (("clock_health"."healthy_count"=0 and "clock_health"."healthy_since_ns" is null and "clock_health"."healthy_last_ns" is null)
      or ("clock_health"."healthy_count">0 and "clock_health"."healthy_since_ns" is not null and "clock_health"."healthy_since_ns">=0 and "clock_health"."healthy_last_ns" is not null and "clock_health"."healthy_last_ns">="clock_health"."healthy_since_ns"))
    and ("clock_health"."state" not in ('HEALTHY','WARNING') or (not "clock_health"."fault_latched" and "clock_health"."running" and "clock_health"."healthy_count"=7 and "clock_health"."received_ns" is not null and "clock_health"."report" is not null))
    and ("clock_health"."received_ns" is null or "clock_health"."received_ns">=0)
    and ("clock_health"."report" is null or (jsonb_typeof("clock_health"."report")='object' and octet_length("clock_health"."report"::text)<=4096))

clock_clearance_shape.name: clock_clearance_shape
clock_clearance_shape.value: "clock_clearances"."generation">0 and "clock_clearances"."report_sequence">0 and octet_length("clock_clearances"."fingerprint")=32 and octet_length("clock_clearances"."reason") between 1 and 1024 and length(btrim("clock_clearances"."reason"))>0

staff_flow_shape.name: staff_flow_shape
staff_flow_shape.value:
octet_length("staff_entry_flows"."proof_verifier")=32 and "staff_entry_flows"."expires_at"="staff_entry_flows"."created_at"+interval '10 minutes'
    and "staff_entry_flows"."mode" in ('NORMAL','CLOCK_RECOVERY') and "staff_entry_flows"."generation">=0 and ("staff_entry_flows"."mode"<>'CLOCK_RECOVERY' or "staff_entry_flows"."generation">0)
    and "staff_entry_flows"."state" in ('OPEN','ACTIVATED','EXPIRED','REVOKED','SUPERSEDED')
    and (("staff_entry_flows"."session_id" is null and "staff_entry_flows"."activated_at" is null and "staff_entry_flows"."state"<>'ACTIVATED')
      or ("staff_entry_flows"."session_id" is not null and "staff_entry_flows"."activated_at" is not null and "staff_entry_flows"."state"<>'OPEN' and "staff_entry_flows"."activated_at">="staff_entry_flows"."created_at" and "staff_entry_flows"."activated_at"<"staff_entry_flows"."expires_at"))

staff_delivery_shape.name: staff_delivery_shape
staff_delivery_shape.value: length("staff_session_deliveries"."key_id") between 1 and 64 and (("staff_session_deliveries"."ciphertext" is not null and octet_length("staff_session_deliveries"."ciphertext") between 1 and 4096 and "staff_session_deliveries"."purged_at" is null) or ("staff_session_deliveries"."ciphertext" is null and "staff_session_deliveries"."purged_at" is not null))

staff_session_lifetime.name: staff_session_lifetime
staff_session_lifetime.value:
octet_length("staff_sessions"."secret_verifier")=32 and "staff_sessions"."absolute_expires_at"="staff_sessions"."created_at"+interval '8 hours'
    and "staff_sessions"."last_activity_at">="staff_sessions"."created_at" and "staff_sessions"."last_activity_at"<"staff_sessions"."absolute_expires_at"
    and "staff_sessions"."mode" in ('NORMAL','CLOCK_RECOVERY') and "staff_sessions"."generation">=0 and ("staff_sessions"."mode"<>'CLOCK_RECOVERY' or "staff_sessions"."generation">0)
    and (("staff_sessions"."revoked_at" is null and "staff_sessions"."revocation_reason" is null) or ("staff_sessions"."revoked_at" is not null and "staff_sessions"."revoked_at">="staff_sessions"."created_at" and "staff_sessions"."revocation_reason" is not null))

operator_bootstrap_shape.name: operator_bootstrap_shape
operator_bootstrap_shape.value:
"operator_bootstraps"."control_id"=1
  and octet_length("operator_bootstraps"."operator") between 1 and 120 and octet_length("operator_bootstraps"."os_user") between 1 and 120
  and octet_length("operator_bootstraps"."reason") between 1 and 1024 and length(btrim("operator_bootstraps"."reason"))>0 and octet_length("operator_bootstraps"."fingerprint")=32

staff_management_shape.name: staff_management_shape
staff_management_shape.value:
"staff_management_outcomes"."control_id"=1 and "staff_management_outcomes"."expected_revision">=0 and octet_length("staff_management_outcomes"."fingerprint")=32
    and octet_length("staff_management_outcomes"."reason") between 1 and 1024 and length(btrim("staff_management_outcomes"."reason"))>0
    and "staff_management_outcomes"."action" in ('CREATE','UPDATE','ROTATE') and "staff_management_outcomes"."outcome" in ('APPLIED','UNCHANGED','REJECTED')
    and (("staff_management_outcomes"."outcome"='REJECTED' and "staff_management_outcomes"."denial_reason" is not null and "staff_management_outcomes"."denial_reason" in ('STALE_VERSION','STAFF_CAPACITY')) or ("staff_management_outcomes"."outcome"<>'REJECTED' and "staff_management_outcomes"."denial_reason" is null))
    and (("staff_management_outcomes"."action"='CREATE' and "staff_management_outcomes"."target_staff_id" is null and "staff_management_outcomes"."display_name" is not null and "staff_management_outcomes"."role" is not null and "staff_management_outcomes"."enabled" is not null and "staff_management_outcomes"."enabled"=true)
      or ("staff_management_outcomes"."action"='UPDATE' and "staff_management_outcomes"."target_staff_id" is not null and "staff_management_outcomes"."display_name" is not null and "staff_management_outcomes"."role" is not null and "staff_management_outcomes"."enabled" is not null)
      or ("staff_management_outcomes"."action"='ROTATE' and "staff_management_outcomes"."target_staff_id" is not null and "staff_management_outcomes"."display_name" is null and "staff_management_outcomes"."role" is null and "staff_management_outcomes"."enabled" is null))
    and ("staff_management_outcomes"."display_name" is null or (octet_length("staff_management_outcomes"."display_name") between 1 and 120 and length(btrim("staff_management_outcomes"."display_name"))>0))
    and ("staff_management_outcomes"."role" is null or "staff_management_outcomes"."role" in ('OWNER','ORGANISER'))
    and (("staff_management_outcomes"."action"='CREATE' and "staff_management_outcomes"."outcome"='APPLIED' and "staff_management_outcomes"."result_staff_id" is not null) or (("staff_management_outcomes"."action"<>'CREATE' or "staff_management_outcomes"."outcome"<>'APPLIED') and "staff_management_outcomes"."result_staff_id" is null))
    and (("staff_management_outcomes"."action" in ('CREATE','ROTATE') and "staff_management_outcomes"."outcome"='APPLIED' and "staff_management_outcomes"."result_credential_id" is not null)
      or (("staff_management_outcomes"."action"='UPDATE' or "staff_management_outcomes"."outcome"<>'APPLIED') and "staff_management_outcomes"."result_credential_id" is null))
    and ("staff_management_outcomes"."action"='UPDATE' or "staff_management_outcomes"."outcome"<>'UNCHANGED')
    and ("staff_management_outcomes"."before_state" is null or (jsonb_typeof("staff_management_outcomes"."before_state")='object' and octet_length("staff_management_outcomes"."before_state"::text)<=1024))
    and ("staff_management_outcomes"."after_state" is null or (jsonb_typeof("staff_management_outcomes"."after_state")='object' and octet_length("staff_management_outcomes"."after_state"::text)<=1024))

replacement_decision_shape.name: replacement_decision_shape
replacement_decision_shape.value:
"replacement_decisions"."action" in ('APPROVE','REJECT') and "replacement_decisions"."expected_revision">=0 and octet_length("replacement_decisions"."fingerprint")=32
    and octet_length("replacement_decisions"."reason") between 1 and 1024 and length(btrim("replacement_decisions"."reason"))>0
    and (("replacement_decisions"."outcome"='APPLIED' and "replacement_decisions"."denial_reason" is null) or ("replacement_decisions"."outcome"='REJECTED' and "replacement_decisions"."denial_reason" in ('STALE_REQUEST','EXPIRED','ROUND_UNAVAILABLE','ACCESS_UNAVAILABLE','HANDOFF_RESERVED')))

arena_setup_target.name: arena_setup_target
arena_setup_target.value:
("arena_setup_outcomes"."action"='CREATE' and "arena_setup_outcomes"."control_id" is not null and "arena_setup_outcomes"."control_id"=1 and "arena_setup_outcomes"."round_id" is null)
    or ("arena_setup_outcomes"."action"='CONFIGURE' and "arena_setup_outcomes"."control_id" is null and "arena_setup_outcomes"."round_id" is not null)

arena_setup_payload.name: arena_setup_payload
arena_setup_payload.value:
octet_length("arena_setup_outcomes"."fingerprint")=32 and "arena_setup_outcomes"."expected_revision">=0 and "arena_setup_outcomes"."duration_ms" between 1 and 18000000
    and octet_length("arena_setup_outcomes"."reason") between 1 and 1024 and length(btrim("arena_setup_outcomes"."reason"))>0

arena_setup_result.name: arena_setup_result
arena_setup_result.value:
("arena_setup_outcomes"."outcome" in ('APPLIED','UNCHANGED') and "arena_setup_outcomes"."denial_reason" is null and "arena_setup_outcomes"."result_instance_id" is not null
      and "arena_setup_outcomes"."result_round_id" is not null and "arena_setup_outcomes"."result_revision" is not null and "arena_setup_outcomes"."result_revision">=0 and ("arena_setup_outcomes"."outcome"<>'UNCHANGED' or "arena_setup_outcomes"."action"='CONFIGURE'))
    or ("arena_setup_outcomes"."outcome"='REJECTED' and "arena_setup_outcomes"."denial_reason" is not null and "arena_setup_outcomes"."denial_reason" in ('STALE_VERSION','ARENA_RESERVED','ROUND_UNAVAILABLE','TEAM_INCOMPLETE')
      and "arena_setup_outcomes"."result_instance_id" is null and "arena_setup_outcomes"."result_round_id" is null and "arena_setup_outcomes"."result_revision" is null)
